purpose: Bounded OAK Media Authenticity regression/bake-off categories. Ground truth is independent of detector output and this manifest must never be used to manufacture an accuracy percentage from tiny samples.

caseContract.file: relative path to a local/licensed fixture
caseContract.groundTruthNote: bounded factual provenance of fixture ground truth
caseContract.licenseNote: fixture/dataset terms proving this use is permitted

candidatePolicy.universalfakedetect: production specialist #1 unless controlled evaluation disproves the choice
candidatePolicy.safe: candidate only; requires license/checkpoint/runtime validation and complementary OAK results before promotion
candidatePolicy.aide: research only where dataset/checkpoint terms permit; Chameleon is not permitted for OAK commercial use
candidatePolicy.iapl: research only until license and checkpoint terms are established
candidatePolicy.probe_aigi_detection: research/failure-analysis only until license/runtime/complementarity are established
candidatePolicy.sida: localization research only; never display a simulated heatmap
